thesis: This episode argues that major financial institutions are moving beyond simple speculation to build specific, on-chain infrastructure for crypto. The speaker highlights that legacy banks like Morgan Stanley and BlackRock are adopting 'thoughtful' and 'instrumental' approaches to integrate crypto products and stablecoin settlement, while Robinhood is aggressively tokenizing assets and bringing equities on-chain.
